questions.question: Why did God let King Jehoash of Israel defeat King Amaziah of Judah in battle?

answers.text: Judah had sought the gods of Edom
Judah had broken a treaty with Israel
Judah had ignored the Sabbath day

answers.text: Broke down a long section of it
Set his guards all along it
